summary.name: No Stairs Please MCP
summary.one_liner: A remote MCP server that gives ChatGPT, Claude or Gemini live search access to a database of about 45,600 small and mid-size North American live-music venues for routing tours and drafting booking emails.
keywords: dive bars that book original music
use_cases: Plan a multi-stop band tour with venues in driving order
Find small venues that book original music on specific nights
Look up which rooms a band has played
Draft personalized booking pitch emails to venues
Track follow-ups with venues that have not replied
Build a routing sheet from saved favorite venues
summary.what_it_does: The page describes a remote MCP server at nostairsplease.com/mcp that connects to ChatGPT, Claude or Gemini via OAuth 2.1. It exposes tools to search venues by location, capacity, music night, genre and radius, and to calculate multi-stop tour routes with a map link. It can look up a band's past show listings across venues, fetch venue records, and reveal booking contacts and music nights. It also lets the AI save or remove Favorites and check account access level and reveal counts. The page says the assistant can pair with an email integration to draft and send booking pitches and follow-ups.
notable: Multi-stop tour routing along the highway with an interactive map link
Find where a band or solo songwriter has played across listed venues
Dedicated music-booking email contacts kept separate from general contacts
caveats: Full booking contacts, ticket prices and show dates require All Access ($25 for one month or $200 for one year, one-time, no renewal) or reveals
Free tier gives only 4 one-time venue reveals without an account, or 10 with a free account
Gemini custom apps are listed as available only on personal US Google accounts
